items.title: CrowdStrike (CRWD) CTO Exit Puts AI Security Leadership In Focus
items.summary: CrowdStrike Holdings (NasdaqGS:CRWD) global CTO Elia Zaitsev is departing to launch an AI focused cybersecurity venture fund called Cognition. Zaitsev's exit marks a leadership change for CrowdStrike at a time when the company is expanding in AI powered security. The new fund is expected to focus on AI driven cybersecurity startups, which may influence competition, talent flows and partnerships across the sector.
